evidence.title: CRHR1 antagonists reduce stress-induced anxiety behaviour in rats
evidence.text: Corticotropin-releasing hormone receptor 1 (CRHR1) mediates the endocrine stress response. Oral administration of a selective CRHR1 antagonist reduced anxiety-like behaviour and ACTH release in rats exposed to restraint stress.

evidence.title: Genetic variation at 17q21.31 and Parkinson's disease risk
evidence.text: The 17q21.31 inversion region contains MAPT, KANSL1, CRHR1 and several readthrough transcripts including LINC02210-CRHR1. The H1 haplotype of this region was associated with Parkinson's disease risk; the causal gene could not be resolved because of strong linkage disequilibrium.

evidence.title: Gene function
evidence.text: Naturally occurring readthrough transcription between neighboring genes LINC02210 and CRHR1. The readthrough transcript encodes a protein that shares sequence identity with the product of the CRHR1 gene.
